label: Bible Study
prompt: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and _____ us.
verse: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
note: Paul's night vision — the call that sent his team across the sea to Macedonia.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: When the morning stars _____ together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verse: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
note: God's view of creation day: the morning stars sang together and the sons of God shouted for joy.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the _____ that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
verse: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
note: Solomon lectured on everything from the mighty cedar to the humble hyssop growing out of a wall.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the _____ of them that slept.
verse: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
note: Firstfruits were the first sheaf of harvest offered to God — Christ's rising guarantees the rest of the crop.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The grass _____, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the LORD bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.
verse: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the LORD bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.
note: The grass 'withereth,' the flower fadeth — but the very next verse says the word of our God shall stand for ever.
